papers.title_en: TwinPrune: Density-Aware Two-Phase Token Pruning for Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Kai Liu, Anqi Li, Junxian Li, Zhixin Wang, Zhikai Chen, Renjing Pei, Yulun Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向视觉语言模型的密度感知双阶段Token剪枝
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型在预填充与解码两阶段均需压缩视觉 token，但现有评估常把预填充探针误当解码性能。TwinPrune 用统一空间密度信号为两阶段打分：预填充做二分合并，解码做密度 top-k KV 驱逐。在七种模型变体与三类全流程基准上取得计算、显存和精度的三向 Pareto 前沿。并指出解码阶段声明必须用 MM-Vet 或 DocVQA 等全流程基准验证。
papers.abstract_en: We propose a unified spatial-density signal to score token importance for both inference phases: bipartite merge for prefill and KV eviction for decode, yielding measurable gains in each stage. To isolate the two phases, we split benchmarks by scoring logic. Prefill probes (MMBench, POPE, ScienceQA) evaluate only the first decoded token; their accuracy reflects prefill logits argmax before any decode KV eviction. Full-pipeline probes (TextVQA, DocVQA, MM-Vet) assess the complete generated sequence and capture both phases. We identify a critical evaluation pitfall: decode pruning claims validated solely on prefill probes measure prefill quality, not decode performance. Experiments show discarding all visual KV during decode barely affects prefill-probe accuracy but degrades TextVQA and MM-Vet drastically; this insensitivity stems from the scoring rule, not compression intensity.Evaluated on seven model variants (InternVL-3.5, Qwen3-VL, LLaVA-1.5) and three full-pipeline benchmarks, our method achieves a three-way Pareto frontier across compute, memory and accuracy. Density-based prefill compression maintains strong accuracy, scales linearly with visual token count, and delivers 100x faster token selection at high resolution. For decode, density top-k KV eviction consistently outperforms strong baselines H2O, SnapKV and StreamingLLM on TextVQA and MM-Vet across three retention ratios. At 0.125 keep ratio on TextVQA, it surpasses H2O by 9.6 points; InternVL-3.5 models (2B to 38B) maintain a 7 to 10 point advantage. Compression scales favorably with model size: every measured 8B to 38B model transition reduces accuracy loss instead of worsening it. We suggest MM-Vet or DocVQA as mandatory full-pipeline validation for any decode-phase claims. Our code is available at https://github.com/Kai-Liu001/TwinPrune

papers.title_en: Bifocal: Training-Free Mixed Granularity Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal LLMs
papers.authors: Peiran Yin, Hao Wu, Zihao Yang, Fengyu Zhou, Yijuan Liang, Haozhe Hu, Xudong Wang, Wei Zhang, Xiaoyu Shen
papers.evidence: 面向多模态LLM的无训练混合粒度视觉token剪枝
papers.tldr: 现有视觉 token 剪枝能用约四分之一 token 保持通用 VQA 性能，但在 OCR、视觉定位等细粒度任务上严重退化，原因是单一排序和稀疏 patch 选择破坏互补证据与空间完整性。Bifocal 提出免训练两阶段混合粒度剪枝：LLM 前按问题相关性与图像内在覆盖度分配预算并保留全图池化粗表示，LLM 内用密度校正的图文注意力再剪枝。在三个 MLLM 家族、五类能力组中，它成为唯一各组保留超 90% 未剪枝性能的方法，并在九个模型-预算设置平均排名第一。
papers.abstract_en: Visual token pruning for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) appears highly effective, with existing methods retaining over 95% of unpruned performance on common VQA benchmarks using a quarter of the visual tokens or fewer. However, our extensive evaluation of ten methods across three MLLM families and five ability groups reveals a critical gap: strong general performance often comes at the cost of severe degradation on fine-grained tasks such as OCR and visual grounding. We trace these failures to two limitations of the prevailing paradigm of retaining the highest-ranked native patches. A single importance ranking overlooks the complementary evidence required by different tasks, while sparse patch selection disrupts both image content and spatial integrity. To address these limitations, we propose Bifocal, a training-free, two-stage pruning method built on a mixed-granularity framework. It allocates separate budgets to query-focused and image-intrinsic evidence, complemented by a pooled coarse representation of the entire image. Before the LLM, Bifocal matches question words to visual regions through a soft conjunction balanced against norm-debiased image saliency, while selecting image-intrinsic evidence to maximize representational coverage. Inside the LLM, it further prunes tokens using density-adjusted text-to-image attention. With roughly a quarter of the original visual tokens, Bifocal is the only evaluated method to retain over 90% of unpruned performance in every ability group across all three models, and ranks first on average in all nine model-budget settings. The code is available at: https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Bifocal

papers.title_en: Visual Tokens on Demand: Visual Budgeting for Scalable and Efficient Multi-Image Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs
papers.authors: Aimon Rahman, Joymallya Chakraborty, Vidit Bansal, Abhishek Dan
papers.evidence: 通过视觉预算进行视觉标记剪枝与合并
papers.tldr: 多模态大模型多图推理成本高，每张图都会引入大量视觉token，现有压缩方法多面向单图且需重训或访问注意力矩阵。本文提出轻量即插即用模块mmVB，用跨图上下文为每张图分配查询条件的token预算，仅增1.6M可训练参数。它把视觉输入token减少9倍，首token时延快5倍，prefill FLOPs降7倍，在八个多图推理基准上保留94.4%全分辨率准确率，实现免重训的可扩展高效多图推理。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models have advanced rapidly, but most remain optimized for single-image inputs. Multi-image reasoning is costly because each image adds many visual tokens, increasing encoding and attention demands. Existing techniques that address the above issue, including visual token pruning, token merging, visual token compression, learned resampling, hierarchical compression, retrieval-augmented visual reasoning, and memory-based architectures, have largely been designed for single-image scenarios, where redundancy is primarily spatial and local. Multi-image reasoning introduces additional challenges: redundancy may occur across images, task-relevant evidence may be sparse or distributed, and aggressive per-image compression can remove details needed for comparison, counting, temporal reasoning, retrieval, or evidence grounding. Moreover, existing token-reduction methods are often either (i) training-free but inference-inefficient, typically relying on accessing attention matrices to get token-importance that may be impractical to access with memory-efficient attention implementations such as FlashAttention, or (ii) training-dependent, requiring the base MLLM to be retrained or adapted to a new compressed-token paradigm. In this work, we study scalable multi-image reasoning and understanding without retraining the base model and without accessing attention matrices at inference time. To this end, we propose mmVB, a lightweight plug-and-play module that assigns query-conditioned per-image token budgets via cross-image context, adding only 1.6M trainable parameters while reducing visual input tokens by 9x. This reduction yields 5x faster time-to-first-token and 7x fewer prefill FLOPs, while maintaining 94.4% of full-resolution accuracy across eight multi-image reasoning benchmarks.

papers.title_en: How Much Can We Prune? Exploring the Performance Limits of Visual Token Pruning
papers.authors: Janghoon Cho, Shubhankar Borse, Reza Pourreza, Juntae Lee, Jihwan Bang, Munawar Hayat, Fatih Porikli
papers.evidence: 视觉语言模型中视觉Token剪枝的性能极限
papers.tldr: 视觉token剪枝可降低VLM显存与推理成本，但现有方法难以区分性能瓶颈来自选择算法还是剪枝上限。作者把通用图像理解剪枝建模为固定预算下选一个共享token子集，借助前沿VLM生成辅助QA并冻结被评模型优化答案概率，提出QA-MBG贪心构造嵌套子集。在Qwen3-VL-4B和Gemma 4 E4B、9个基准900张图上，每图约0.5 H100 GPU小时即可搜索至0.3保留率，留出QA与长文本生成显著超过基线并逼近全token推理。
papers.abstract_en: Visual token pruning is increasingly used to reduce the memory and inference costs of vision-language models. Existing work has largely focused on designing method-specific selectors and demonstrating incremental improvements over prior methods at selected token budgets. It remains unclear whether the resulting performance reflects an inherent limit of visual token pruning or the limitations of current token-selection algorithms. We take a complementary perspective and ask: \emph{how well can visual token pruning perform when offline search cost is not the primary constraint?} We formulate pruning for general image understanding as selecting, under a fixed budget, one shared visual-token subset that supports a broad distribution of questions about an image. We approximate this utility with a finite auxiliary QA set generated by a frontier VLM and optimize a teacher-forced answer-probability objective with the evaluated model frozen. Motivated by the conceptual monotonicity and diminishing returns of adding visual evidence, we construct nested subsets greedily and introduce \emph{QA mini-batch greedy} (QA-MBG), which estimates token marginal gains from randomly sampled QA components at each step. Empirically, QA-MBG is both cheaper and more effective than full greedy. With one frontier-VLM call and approximately $0.5$ H100 GPU-hours per image, it produces a nested subset trajectory covering keep ratios up to $0.3$. Across Qwen3-VL-4B and Gemma~4 E4B on $900$ images from nine benchmarks, we find significant headroom over evaluated pruning baselines on held-out QA and image-grounded long-form generation, while the searched subsets substantially narrow the gap to full-token inference.

papers.title_en: Scaling Vision Transformers Without Training: Prune-and-Merge Token Compression
papers.authors: Vatsal, Soumil Malhotra, Priyanshu Chahal, Sanjeev Kumar
papers.evidence: 视觉Transformer的免训练剪枝合并Token压缩
papers.tldr: 视觉Transformer因token二次交互计算开销高，免训练token缩减方法虽提效但鲁棒性尚未充分评估。本文提出免训练Prune-and-Merge ViT，将类注意力剪枝与相似度合并结合，压缩冗余token并保留语义信息。作者引入相对精度下降和预测翻转率两项指标，在预训练ViT与DeiT上验证。结果表明该方法在竞争性降低计算量时保持鲁棒性，精度优于现有方法，且不引发幻觉式行为并维持预测稳定。
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers achieve strong performance but incur high computational costs from quadratic token interactions. Training-free token reduction methods improve efficiency, but their robustness remains underexplored. We propose Prune-and Merge ViT, a training-free framework for off-the-shelf models. It combines class attention-based pruning with similarity-based merging to reduce redundancy while preserving semantic information. To evaluate robustness we introduce two metrics. Relative Accuracy Drop (RAD) measures relative accuracy degradation under transformations, and Prediction Flip Rate (PFR) quantifies prediction consistency. On pretrained ViT and DeiT, Prune-and-Merge reduces computation competitively while maintaining robustness and better accuracy than existing token reduction methods. Our analysis suggests that hybrid token reduction does not introduce hallucination-like behavior and preserves prediction stability for common image transformations.

papers.title_en: Lightweight but Linguistically Fair? Quantisation Robustness across Bavarian, German, and English
papers.authors: Jophin John, Michael Hoffmann, Piroska Lendvai, Florent Dufour
papers.evidence: 比较LLM上8位与4位GPTQ和AWQ训练后量化
papers.tldr: 后训练量化能降低大模型内存，但是否公平保留巴伐利亚语等区域变体仍不清楚。作者用206题三语对齐的BAVGROUND，在14个7B–10B指令模型上比较BF16、8位GPTQ及4位GPTQ/AWQ。8位GPTQ接近BF16并大体保持三语相对表现；4位量化平均准确率降约1.4–1.5个百分点，改变11.9–16.0%决策，且未形成稳定的巴伐利亚语劣势。结果表明量化稳健性受模型、方法、校准数据和评测方式共同影响，不能只看多语平均准确率。
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantisation reduces the memory cost of large language models, but it remains unclear whether compression preserves language skills of regional varieties as reliably as their standard-language counterparts. We study this question for Bavarian, Standard German, and English using BAVGROUND, a multiple-choice benchmark, where 206 source questions are aligned across all three languages. Across 14 open-weight 7B--10B instruction models, we compare BF16 with 8-bit GPTQ and two 4-bit settings, GPTQ and AWQ. Eight-bit GPTQ remains close to BF16 and largely preserves the relative behaviour of the three languages, while 4-bit quantisation was found to be much less stable. The two 4-bit methods reduce average accuracy by about 1.4--1.5 percentage points and change 11.9--16.0% of BF16 decisions, with changes concentrated on examples where the BF16 model is already uncertain. This instability does not translate into a consistent Bavarian disadvantage. Although Bavarian, a low-resource dialect, has lower baseline accuracy than German and English, the language most affected at 4 bits varies across models and quantisation methods. Calibration further shapes these cross-language effects: the relative Bavarian--German effect changes with calibration language, while changing the calibration source has little average effect on GPTQ-4 but can affect AWQ-4 much more strongly. Free-form evaluation on five models further shows that 4-bit compression can degrade generated responses even in settings where multiple-choice accuracy changes only modestly, while 8-bit GPTQ remains comparatively stable. Overall, our results show that quantisation robustness for regional language varieties depends on the model, quantisation method, calibration data, and evaluation setting, and cannot be measured by aggregate multilingual accuracy alone.

papers.title_en: Just Respect the Semantics: Image-Token Compression via Pre-LLM Semantic Variable-Resolution Tokenization and In-LLM Relevance Pruning
papers.authors: Tianhao Fu, Austin Wang, Charles Chen, Roby Aldave-Garza, Victor Xie, Xiyue Jiao, Yucheng Chen, Martin Tin
papers.evidence: 图像视觉令牌的合并与剪枝压缩
papers.tldr: 图像 token 压缩需在降低计算的同时保住语义，但统一压缩易损边界与文字细节。Varest 依据语义可替换性，用目标与文本定位器引导变分辨率合并，并在解码早期后用 [REL] 寄存器剪枝视觉 token。在三个骨干和 13 个基准上，它于各预算均优于 15 个基线，仅用原图 token 的 5.56% 即保留 86.10–92.33% 全 token 性能。该工作表明语义感知的分辨率分配与相关性剪枝可兼顾效率与语义。
papers.abstract_en: Image-token compression must reduce computation without hurting the semantics. We introduce Varest, guided by semantic fungibility: tokens within a coherent semantic region can be summarized coarsely, while object boundaries and literal text require finer distinctions. Object and text localizers guide variable-resolution merging, preserving spatial coverage and finer detail at boundaries and text. Learned [REL] registers then prune visual tokens after early decoder processing. Training across budgets enables one checkpoint per backbone. Across three backbones and 13 benchmarks, Varest outperforms 15 baselines in mean performance retention at every evaluated budget, retaining 86.10-92.33% of full-token performance with only 5.56% of the original layer-averaged image-token count.

papers.title_en: Towards Green AI: Evaluating Energy Efficiency for Quantized LLM Inference
papers.evidence: 对10种LLM训练后量化策略进行统一评测
papers.tldr: 大模型量化虽能降低显存，但其能耗与碳强度影响缺乏统一评估。本文在四类GPU上对5个模型、10种仅权重量化策略跨多数据集评测精度、时延与能耗。发现输入长输出短时量化能效最高，融合核int8最高省能约4倍且精度损失可忽略。能耗与运行时高度相关，可用时延优化代理降碳，并为按推理需求选低能耗量化提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: While it is known that quantization of large language models (LLMs) reduces memory usage via lower-bit weights, studies quantifying the resulting impact on energy usage and carbon intensity are scarce. We present the first unified evaluation of weight-only quantization strategies for LLM inference across varying input/output lengths and GPUs, highlighting differences in energy efficiency in addition to accuracy degradation and runtime. We study quantized inference on Llama 2 7B, Phi 3.5 Mini Instruct, OLMo 1B, Qwen 2.5 7B, and Qwen 2.5 14B across GLUE MNLI, MMLU, HumanEval, and GSM8K datasets, evaluating 10 post-training quantization (PTQ) strategies on NVIDIA H100, A6000, A100, and L4 GPUs. We identify a novel trend showing that quantization techniques tend to exhibit peak energy efficiency relative to full-precision baselines when inputs are sufficiently long and outputs are short. Furthermore, we show that quantization strategies become marginally more energy-efficient relative to full-precision models as batch sizes increase, though gains are modest. Notably, fused-kernel implementations such as EETQ int8 and Bitsandbytes int8 offer the highest energy savings, up to 4x compared to FP32 on short text generation, with negligible accuracy loss. Finally, we observe that energy usage closely tracks runtime on our evaluated benchmarks, indicating that, in practice, latency optimization can serve as a reliable proxy for reducing the environmental footprint of LLM services. We conclude with suggested directions for strategically selecting low-carbon quantization strategies based on specific inference requirements.

papers.title_en: DVTR-KD: Distilling Vision-Language Models via Intermediate Visual Token Reconstruction
papers.authors: Haolan Wei, Jiahui Wang, Junli Zha, Xinkai Lu, Yunxiao Zou, Chao Zhou, Xiang Song
papers.evidence: 多模态大模型中的视觉Token压缩与蒸馏
papers.tldr: 多模态大模型性能强但计算开销大，边缘部署受限；视觉token压缩虽能降本，却造成师生token数不匹配，阻碍逐token知识迁移。DVTR-KD让学生压缩视觉token重建教师稠密视觉状态，并在关键中间层以教师响应预测和注意力读出损失进行监督。多基准实验显示，该方法提升token压缩学生性能，同时保留压缩带来的推理效率。其意义在于为异构视觉token场景提供有效的蒸馏路径。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on diverse vision-language tasks, but their computational demands limit deployment under constrained budgets, particularly on edge devices. Many works focus on Knowledge Distillation (KD) and try to transfer knowledge from powerful teacher models to students. In addition to reducing model size, visual token compression provides a complementary route to efficiency, but introduces mismatched visual token counts that complicate direct token-wise knowledge transfer. To mitigate this, we propose DVTR-KD, a knowledge distillation framework based on \textbf{D}ense \textbf{V}isual \textbf{T}oken \textbf{R}econstruction, which reconstructs the teacher's dense visual tokens from the student's compressed tokens. We reconstruct visual states after the final LLM layer and at the input to an intermediate layer identified as important for visual-information readout. At the intermediate layer, reconstruction is supervised through the teacher's response predictions rather than by direct token-wise KL or MSE matching. An auxiliary attention-readout loss complements this response-level supervision by aligning how the student and the original teacher integrate contextual information when predicting responses. Evaluations on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that DVTR-KD improves the performance of token-compressed students while retaining the inference efficiency afforded by visual token compression.

papers.title_en: Revisiting Error Feedback for Model Quantization
papers.authors: Wai-Yiu Keung, Chi Cui, Wing-Kin Ma, Jesús Cid-Sueiro, Hei Victor Cheng
papers.evidence: 研究量化误差的旋转-反馈迹最优及GPTQ/LDLQ反馈
papers.tldr: 针对模型量化中的误差反馈系数设计，本文将瞬时量化误差建模为零均值独立同方差变量，把反馈系数选择转化为依赖度量矩阵的迹优化问题。该形式兼容GPTQ/LDLQ固定阶反馈，并可引入Jacobian以考虑下游误差传播。理论上证明正定度量下旋转-反馈联合迹最小值为 n det(H)^{1/n}，并给出基于几何均值分解的达到方案。实验显示下游敏感反馈有收益，但迹最优未必提升有限级量化表现。
papers.abstract_en: We study causal error-feedback coefficients as design variables for model quantization. Modeling instantaneous quantization errors as independent, zero-mean variables with a common fixed variance, we formulated a metric-dependent trace problem for designing feedback coefficients. The formulation resembles fixed-order GPTQ/LDLQ feedback and supports Jacobian-aware designs that account for downstream error propagation. For a positive-definite metric $\boldsymbol{H}$, we prove that the joint rotation-feedback trace minimum is $n\det(\boldsymbol{H})^{1/n}$ and present an attaining pair using the geometric mean decomposition. Experiments on synthetic networks, trained MLPs, and language models show benefits from downstream-sensitive feedback, but also reveal that trace optimality need not improve finite-level performance. Small QAT experiments further illustrate direct loss-driven feedback tuning with fixed or trainable network weights.

papers.title_en: MultiAlloc: Budget-Aware Precision Allocation for KV Cache Quantization
papers.authors: Yangchengyu Zhou, Zhiping Wu, Runchang Jiang, Dongdong Ren, Youfang Han, Wei Zhao, Dongqi Cai, Wenbin Li
papers.evidence: 面向LLM推理的KV缓存量化与预算感知精度分配
papers.tldr: KV cache 是 LLM 推理的主要显存开销，长上下文与复杂推理场景尤甚。固定显存预算下，如何在层级精度提升与 token 级保留之间分配有限的量化资源，仍缺统一方案。MultiAlloc 用轻量离线画像刻画层敏感性与 token 重要性，自动导出分配策略并在推理中直接应用，无需在线搜索。在 Mistral、Llama、DeepSeek-Qwen、QwQ 上，匹配预算下于推理与长上下文基准稳定优于层级、token 级及多粒度方法。
papers.abstract_en: The Key-Value (KV) cache constitutes a dominant source of memory consumption during large language model (LLM) inference, particularly in long-context and complex reasoning scenarios. Existing KV cache quantization methods have explored different compression granularities, including layer-wise precision adjustment and token-level information preservation. In practical deployment, however, the key challenge is not merely compression, but how to allocate limited quantization resources among heterogeneous precision preservation strategies under a fixed KV cache memory budget. We propose MultiAlloc, a profiling-guided precision allocation framework for KV cache quantization that adaptively distributes limited quantization resources between layer-wise precision enhancement and token-wise preservation. MultiAlloc employs lightweight offline profiling to characterize layer sensitivity and token importance, enabling adaptive precision allocation under a fixed memory constraint. Guided by the profiled memory--accuracy trade-off, it automatically derives an effective precision allocation strategy without online allocation search, and applies the resulting policy during inference. Extensive experiments on reasoning and long-context benchmarks demonstrate that MultiAlloc consistently improves over layer-wise, token-wise, and recent multi-granularity KV cache quantization methods under matched memory budgets across diverse models, including Mistral, Llama, DeepSeek-Qwen, and QwQ.

papers.title_en: FrameScout: Scouting Query-Relevant Frames for Long Video Understanding
papers.authors: Haonan Hu, Shuhao Chen, Weisen Jiang, Lizhao Gao, James Kwok, Yu Zhang
papers.evidence: 基于查询的关键帧选择在流式KV缓存下减少视觉token并保留时序上下文
papers.tldr: 长视频理解中，VideoLLMs面临视觉token远超处理上限的问题，关键帧选择器成为降本关键。FrameScout针对现有选择器缺乏时序上下文、分块排序目标难优化等缺陷，提出流式选择器架构与帧-查询对比目标。前者用滑动窗口KV缓存和后继聚合生成时序上下文化帧嵌入，后者在共享空间对齐帧与查询以直接训练相关性判别。在三个长视频基准和六个基座VideoLLMs上，FrameScout均取得一致的最优性能，为长视频关键帧筛选提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Long video understanding requires VideoLLMs to answer queries about videos spanning tens of minutes to hours, but such long videos produce far more visual tokens than current VideoLLMs can process. To address this issue, keyframe selectors are proposed to select the most query-relevant frames by computing the similarity between frame and query embeddings. Existing selectors either encode frames independently without temporal context or process chunks in isolation with ranking objectives that are difficult to optimize. To alleviate those limitations, we propose FrameScout with two core designs: (i) a streaming selector architecture that leverages a sliding-window KV cache and successor aggregation to produce temporally-contextualized frame embeddings; (ii) a frame-query contrastive objective that aligns frame and query embeddings in a shared space, directly training the selector to distinguish relevant frames from irrelevant ones. Extensive experiments on three long-video benchmarks and six base VideoLLMs demonstrate that FrameScout consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. Code is available at https://github.com/Hubert-1102/FrameScout.

papers.title_en: DT-LoRA: Reaching Beyond the Tangent Space of Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.authors: Yangming Zhang, Ling Yi, Datong Li, Jinliang Ding, Xiaojie Wang, Tiecheng Song, Zhaolong Ning
papers.evidence: 超越LoRA切空间的低秩适配
papers.tldr: LoRA因分解更新受限于当前低秩因子的切空间，残差梯度方向未被利用而落后于全量微调。DT-LoRA将固定秩预算拆为稳定与动态分支，用无矩阵随机SVD捕捉主残差梯度方向，并以受控回写保持累积更新。方法不增可训练参数或推理开销，在视觉与NLP任务上稳定优于LoRA及变体。作为通用适配方法，它还在开放词汇域泛化语义分割上超越任务专用方案并取得SOTA。
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) often underperforms full fine-tuning. We investigate this performance gap through a tangent-space lens: factorized updates are confined to the tangent space of the current low-rank factors, leaving gradient components outside this space unexploited. An analysis of ten representative LoRA variants reveals that these residual components account for most of the gradient energy and exhibit strong spectral concentration. Motivated by this finding, we propose Dynamic Tangent LoRA (DT-LoRA), which partitions a fixed rank budget into a stable branch and a dynamic branch to capture the principal residual gradient directions. We show that these directions define the optimal update of a local quadratic model under orthogonal-complement and rank constraints. Matrix-free randomized SVD recovers them without materializing the residual gradient, while controlled write-back preserves accumulated updates and stabilizes training within the allocated rank. DT-LoRA adds no trainable parameters or inference cost over LoRA. Experiments across computer vision and natural language processing tasks demonstrate consistent improvements over LoRA and its variants. Moreover, despite being a general-purpose adaptation method, DT-LoRA outperforms task-specific approaches to open-vocabulary domain generalization for semantic segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art results. Code is available at https://github.com/Snipine/DT-LoRA.

papers.title_en: AlignPred: Error-Controlled KV Cache Compression via Alignment and Predictive Coding
papers.authors: Xu Yang, Jiapeng Zhang, Zhiwei Zuo, Yuxin Chen, Feiqiang Sun, Chengguang Xu, Feng Jin, Zhuo Tang
papers.evidence: 局部正交变换对齐注意力头并对残差进行误差有界量化
papers.tldr: 长时运行智能体需跨轮次持久保存KV缓存，压缩时必须控制重建误差。AlignPred用局部正交变换把相关头或层对齐到公共坐标系，结合逐token预测与跨头/层同token预测，并将残差在误差有界格点上量化后熵编码。在三种注意力机制下，它以更低存储达到相近重建误差，解码至少快1.6倍，128K LongBench-Pro接近原生分数，SGLang HiCache持久目标KV存储降42-72%。
papers.abstract_en: Long-running agents retain KV caches across turns and sessions for hours or days. Compressing these persistent caches requires reducing storage while controlling reconstruction error. We present AlignPred, a codec that combines local alignment with predictive coding under a configurable KV reconstruction-error budget. Local orthogonal transforms align related heads or layers into a common coordinate frame, allowing AlignPred to combine token-wise prediction with same-token prediction across heads or layers. Residuals are quantized on an error-bounded lattice and entropy-coded, without learned predictors, encoder-side mode search, or large joint transforms. Across three attention mechanisms, AlignPred requires less storage than the evaluated baselines at comparable measured reconstruction error. Against the evaluated CPU codec implementations, it decodes at least 1.6 times faster while matching or improving encode time. AlignPred achieves near-native task scores at substantially compressed operating points on LongBench-Pro at 128K context. AlignPred's SGLang HiCache integration reduces persistent target-KV storage by 42-72% relative to native HiCache, with comparable latency.
